title: Plasmakinetic Enucleation of the Prostate to Treat Benign Prostatic Hypertrophy Patients With Large Prostate
brief_summary: The goal of this study is to compare the perioperative and postoperative characters of plasmakinetic enucleation of the prostate(PkEP) with bipolar TURP(B-TURP) for BPH patients with large prostate.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Qmax \< 10 mL/s, IPSS \>19
* Age between 50 and 70 years
* Prostate volume between 70 and 200 mL, as determined by TRUS, and medical therapy failure.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with neurogenic bladder
* Urethral stricture
* Bladder tumor
* Prostate cancer and previous prostate bladder neck
* Urethral surgery
* PSA\>4ng/ml, or receiving prostate biopsy within 3 months
